name: audio-customizer
description: Desktop audio asset editor (Electron + React UI, Rust engine)

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json
scripts.dist: node scripts/ensure-native.mjs && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.dist:win: node scripts/ensure-native.mjs && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: node scripts/ensure-native.mjs && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: node scripts/ensure-native.mjs && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --linux --publish never

author: Audio Customizer
